A '''[[Hyperbaride/Legends|hyperbaride]] synthesis plant''' was a plant where hyperbarides, a group of extremely rare super-heavy elements, were processed. [[Dynamic Synergetics, Inc.]] owned several of these plants until it was nationalized by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. [[DSI Hyperbaride Synthesis Plant|One such plant]] was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Marca/Legends|Marca]].
